The indicative base-price references I have are roughly RM328k–RM358k, depending on the floor, facing and car-park configuration. I’m checking the latest pricing package so I can give you an up-to-date picture.
Thanks, that’s a useful rough guide. I’m just comparing options for now, so I’ll wait for the confirmed current range and package before judging the total.
